note: result = the effect lands. Debuff immunity (DEBUFF_IMMUNITY stat) returns false without a draw; activateRate -1 / > 99 / no basic property return true without a draw. Otherwise rate = clamp(baseMod * elementMod * traitMod * mAtkMod * buffDebuffMod, minChance, maxChance) (0 when traitMod is 0) and the effect lands when Rnd.get(100) < rate; 'draw' is the d the script makes Rnd.get(100) return (0, 50, 99 and around the threshold; -1 = the call draws nothing). shots: the attacker's charged shots when the case ran (blessed spiritshot raises mAtkMod for magic skills). intermediate: the numbers of the pair. Every case has 'script' (the unit values u in [0,1) that were consumed) and 'rnd' (every Rnd call in order: method, bound, returned value; get_int bound b returns floor(u*b), get_int_range o,b returns o+floor(u*(b-o+1)), nextGaussian is 2u-1 in the harness). Calls that draw nothing are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound.
